q: “Bless the LORD, ye his angels, that excel in ____, that do his commandments, hearkening unto the voice of his word.”
explain: Psalm 103:20 — “Bless the LORD, ye his angels, that excel in strength, that do his commandments, hearkening unto the voice of his word.”

q: “In God have I put my trust: I will not be afraid what ____ can do unto me.”
explain: Psalm 56:11 — “In God have I put my trust: I will not be afraid what man can do unto me.”

q: “Thou hast dealt well with thy ____, O LORD, according unto thy word.”
explain: Psalm 119:65 — “Thou hast dealt well with thy servant, O LORD, according unto thy word.”

q: “For thou, LORD, wilt bless the righteous; with ____ wilt thou compass him as with a shield.”
explain: Psalm 5:12 — “For thou, LORD, wilt bless the righteous; with favour wilt thou compass him as with a shield.”

q: “For he is not a God of the dead, but of the ____: for all live unto him.”
explain: Luke 20:38 — “For he is not a God of the dead, but of the living: for all live unto him.”

q: “Whoso findeth a wife findeth a good thing, and obtaineth ____ of the LORD.”
explain: Proverbs 18:22 — “Whoso findeth a wife findeth a good thing, and obtaineth favour of the LORD.”

q: “There cometh a ____ of Samaria to draw water: Jesus saith unto her, Give me to drink.”
explain: John 4:7 — “There cometh a woman of Samaria to draw water: Jesus saith unto her, Give me to drink.”

q: “Even as Abraham believed God, and it was accounted to him for ____.”
explain: Galatians 3:6 — “Even as Abraham believed God, and it was accounted to him for righteousness.”

q: “Truly God is good to Israel, even to such as are of a clean ____.”
explain: Psalm 73:1 — “Truly God is good to Israel, even to such as are of a clean heart.”

q: “The LORD on high is mightier than the noise of many waters, yea, than the mighty waves of the ____.”
explain: Psalm 93:4 — “The LORD on high is mightier than the noise of many waters, yea, than the mighty waves of the sea.”

q: “Therewith bless we God, even the ____; and therewith curse we men, which are made after the similitude of God.”
explain: James 3:9 — “Therewith bless we God, even the Father; and therewith curse we men, which are made after the similitude of God.”

q: “Look unto me, and be ye saved, all the ends of the ____: for I am God, and there is none else.”
explain: Isaiah 45:22 — “Look unto me, and be ye saved, all the ends of the earth: for I am God, and there is none else.”

q: “I am the LORD thy God, which brought thee out of the land of Egypt, from the house of ____.”
explain: Deuteronomy 5:6 — “I am the LORD thy God, which brought thee out of the land of Egypt, from the house of bondage.”

q: “Let them be before the LORD continually, that he may cut off the memory of them from the ____.”
explain: Psalm 109:15 — “Let them be before the LORD continually, that he may cut off the memory of them from the earth.”

q: “There are not found that returned to give ____ to God, save this stranger.”
explain: Luke 17:18 — “There are not found that returned to give glory to God, save this stranger.”

q: “For Jesus himself testified, that a prophet hath no ____ in his own country.”
explain: John 4:44 — “For Jesus himself testified, that a prophet hath no honour in his own country.”

q: “When I said, My foot slippeth; thy ____, O LORD, held me up.”
explain: Psalm 94:18 — “When I said, My foot slippeth; thy mercy, O LORD, held me up.”

q: “But he that doeth ____ cometh to the light, that his deeds may be made manifest, that they are wrought in God.”
explain: John 3:21 — “But he that doeth truth cometh to the light, that his deeds may be made manifest, that they are wrought in God.”

q: “The LORD by wisdom hath founded the earth; by ____ hath he established the heavens.”
explain: Proverbs 3:19 — “The LORD by wisdom hath founded the earth; by understanding hath he established the heavens.”

q: “In thee, O LORD, do I put my trust; let me never be ashamed: deliver me in thy ____.”
explain: Psalm 31:1 — “In thee, O LORD, do I put my trust; let me never be ashamed: deliver me in thy righteousness.”

q: “When Christ, who is our life, shall appear, then shall ye also appear with him in ____.”
explain: Colossians 3:4 — “When Christ, who is our life, shall appear, then shall ye also appear with him in glory.”

q: “That I may come unto you with ____ by the will of God, and may with you be refreshed.”
explain: Romans 15:32 — “That I may come unto you with joy by the will of God, and may with you be refreshed.”

q: “The floods have lifted up, O LORD, the floods have lifted up their ____; the floods lift up their waves.”
explain: Psalm 93:3 — “The floods have lifted up, O LORD, the floods have lifted up their voice; the floods lift up their waves.”

q: “Wherefore receive ye one another, as Christ also received us to the ____ of God.”
explain: Romans 15:7 — “Wherefore receive ye one another, as Christ also received us to the glory of God.”

q: “Surely such are the dwellings of the ____, and this is the place of him that knoweth not God.”
explain: Job 18:21 — “Surely such are the dwellings of the wicked, and this is the place of him that knoweth not God.”

q: “Until the time that his word ____: the word of the LORD tried him.”
explain: Psalm 105:19 — “Until the time that his word came: the word of the LORD tried him.”

q: “But the LORD is my defence; and my God is the rock of my ____.”
explain: Psalm 94:22 — “But the LORD is my defence; and my God is the rock of my refuge.”

q: “Deliver me from bloodguiltiness, O God, thou God of my salvation: and my tongue shall sing aloud of thy ____.”
explain: Psalm 51:14 — “Deliver me from bloodguiltiness, O God, thou God of my salvation: and my tongue shall sing aloud of thy righteousness.”

q: “For all ____ their own, not the things which are Jesus Christ's.”
explain: Philippians 2:21 — “For all seek their own, not the things which are Jesus Christ's.”

q: “For he stretcheth out his ____ against God, and strengtheneth himself against the Almighty.”
explain: Job 15:25 — “For he stretcheth out his hand against God, and strengtheneth himself against the Almighty.”

q: “Turn us again, O LORD God of hosts, cause thy face to shine; and we shall be ____.”
explain: Psalm 80:19 — “Turn us again, O LORD God of hosts, cause thy face to shine; and we shall be saved.”

q: “Give unto the LORD, O ye mighty, give unto the LORD glory and ____.”
explain: Psalm 29:1 — “Give unto the LORD, O ye mighty, give unto the LORD glory and strength.”

q: “God hath spoken once; twice have I heard this; that ____ belongeth unto God.”
explain: Psalm 62:11 — “God hath spoken once; twice have I heard this; that power belongeth unto God.”

q: “Sing unto the LORD; for he hath done excellent things: this is known in all the ____.”
explain: Isaiah 12:5 — “Sing unto the LORD; for he hath done excellent things: this is known in all the earth.”

q: “The LORD loveth the ____ of Zion more than all the dwellings of Jacob.”
explain: Psalm 87:2 — “The LORD loveth the gates of Zion more than all the dwellings of Jacob.”

q: “The LORD is the portion of mine ____ and of my cup: thou maintainest my lot.”
explain: Psalm 16:5 — “The LORD is the portion of mine inheritance and of my cup: thou maintainest my lot.”

q: “The statutes of the LORD are right, rejoicing the ____: the commandment of the LORD is pure, enlightening the eyes.”
explain: Psalm 19:8 — “The statutes of the LORD are right, rejoicing the heart: the commandment of the LORD is pure, enlightening the eyes.”

q: “Bless the LORD, O my soul. O LORD my God, thou art very great; thou art clothed with ____ and majesty.”
explain: Psalm 104:1 — “Bless the LORD, O my soul. O LORD my God, thou art very great; thou art clothed with honour and majesty.”

q: “He shall cry unto me, Thou art my father, my God, and the rock of my ____.”
explain: Psalm 89:26 — “He shall cry unto me, Thou art my father, my God, and the rock of my salvation.”

q: “O ____ the LORD, all ye his saints: for the LORD preserveth the faithful, and plentifully rewardeth the proud doer.”
explain: Psalm 31:23 — “O love the LORD, all ye his saints: for the LORD preserveth the faithful, and plentifully rewardeth the proud doer.”

q: “O give thanks unto the God of ____: for his mercy endureth for ever.”
explain: Psalm 136:26 — “O give thanks unto the God of heaven: for his mercy endureth for ever.”

q: “Hold fast the form of sound words, which thou hast heard of me, in ____ and love which is in Christ Jesus.”
explain: 2 Timothy 1:13 — “Hold fast the form of sound words, which thou hast heard of me, in faith and love which is in Christ Jesus.”

q: “O God, thou knowest my foolishness; and my ____ are not hid from thee.”
explain: Psalm 69:5 — “O God, thou knowest my foolishness; and my sins are not hid from thee.”

q: “For I the LORD thy God will hold thy right ____, saying unto thee, Fear not; I will help thee.”
explain: Isaiah 41:13 — “For I the LORD thy God will hold thy right hand, saying unto thee, Fear not; I will help thee.”

q: “The LORD is far from the wicked: but he heareth the ____ of the righteous.”
explain: Proverbs 15:29 — “The LORD is far from the wicked: but he heareth the prayer of the righteous.”

q: “In God is my ____ and my glory: the rock of my strength, and my refuge, is in God.”
explain: Psalm 62:7 — “In God is my salvation and my glory: the rock of my strength, and my refuge, is in God.”

q: “All the paths of the LORD are mercy and truth unto such as keep his ____ and his testimonies.”
explain: Psalm 25:10 — “All the paths of the LORD are mercy and truth unto such as keep his covenant and his testimonies.”

q: “O God, my heart is fixed; I will sing and give ____, even with my glory.”
explain: Psalm 108:1 — “O God, my heart is fixed; I will sing and give praise, even with my glory.”

q: “For the LORD knoweth the way of the ____: but the way of the ungodly shall perish.”
explain: Psalm 1:6 — “For the LORD knoweth the way of the righteous: but the way of the ungodly shall perish.”

q: “Because the creature itself also shall be delivered from the ____ of corruption into the glorious liberty of the children of God.”
explain: Romans 8:21 — “Because the creature itself also shall be delivered from the bondage of corruption into the glorious liberty of the children of God.”

q: “For his God doth instruct him to discretion, and doth ____ him.”
explain: Isaiah 28:26 — “For his God doth instruct him to discretion, and doth teach him.”

q: “It is better to ____ in the LORD than to put confidence in princes.”
explain: Psalm 118:9 — “It is better to trust in the LORD than to put confidence in princes.”

q: “Arise, O God, judge the ____: for thou shalt inherit all nations.”
explain: Psalm 82:8 — “Arise, O God, judge the earth: for thou shalt inherit all nations.”

q: “Know ye not, that so many of us as were baptized into Jesus Christ were baptized into his ____?”
explain: Romans 6:3 — “Know ye not, that so many of us as were baptized into Jesus Christ were baptized into his death?”

q: “For strangers are risen up against me, and oppressors seek after my ____: they have not set God before them. Selah.”
explain: Psalm 54:3 — “For strangers are risen up against me, and oppressors seek after my soul: they have not set God before them. Selah.”

q: “This beginning of miracles did Jesus in Cana of Galilee, and manifested forth his ____; and his disciples believed on him.”
explain: John 2:11 — “This beginning of miracles did Jesus in Cana of Galilee, and manifested forth his glory; and his disciples believed on him.”

q: “Sing praises to the LORD, which dwelleth in Zion: declare among the ____ his doings.”
explain: Psalm 9:11 — “Sing praises to the LORD, which dwelleth in Zion: declare among the people his doings.”

q: “But murmured in their tents, and hearkened not unto the ____ of the LORD.”
explain: Psalm 106:25 — “But murmured in their tents, and hearkened not unto the voice of the LORD.”

q: “Whoso is ____, and will observe these things, even they shall understand the lovingkindness of the LORD.”
explain: Psalm 107:43 — “Whoso is wise, and will observe these things, even they shall understand the lovingkindness of the LORD.”

q: “In the ____ when God shall judge the secrets of men by Jesus Christ according to my gospel.”
explain: Romans 2:16 — “In the day when God shall judge the secrets of men by Jesus Christ according to my gospel.”

q: “As the mountains are round about Jerusalem, so the LORD is round about his ____ from henceforth even for ever.”
explain: Psalm 125:2 — “As the mountains are round about Jerusalem, so the LORD is round about his people from henceforth even for ever.”

q: “He that walketh in his uprightness feareth the LORD: but he that is perverse in his ____ despiseth him.”
explain: Proverbs 14:2 — “He that walketh in his uprightness feareth the LORD: but he that is perverse in his ways despiseth him.”

q: “In God we boast all the day long, and ____ thy name for ever. Selah.”
explain: Psalm 44:8 — “In God we boast all the day long, and praise thy name for ever. Selah.”

q: “Favour is deceitful, and beauty is vain: but a ____ that feareth the LORD, she shall be praised.”
explain: Proverbs 31:30 — “Favour is deceitful, and beauty is vain: but a woman that feareth the LORD, she shall be praised.”

q: “All the ways of a ____ are clean in his own eyes; but the LORD weigheth the spirits.”
explain: Proverbs 16:2 — “All the ways of a man are clean in his own eyes; but the LORD weigheth the spirits.”

q: “Fair weather ____ out of the north: with God is terrible majesty.”
explain: Job 37:22 — “Fair weather cometh out of the north: with God is terrible majesty.”

q: “In the fear of the LORD is strong confidence: and his children shall have a place of ____.”
explain: Proverbs 14:26 — “In the fear of the LORD is strong confidence: and his children shall have a place of refuge.”

q: “Which are a ____ of things to come; but the body is of Christ.”
explain: Colossians 2:17 — “Which are a shadow of things to come; but the body is of Christ.”

q: “He that hath pity upon the ____ lendeth unto the LORD; and that which he hath given will he pay him again.”
explain: Proverbs 19:17 — “He that hath pity upon the poor lendeth unto the LORD; and that which he hath given will he pay him again.”

q: “The remnant shall return, even the remnant of Jacob, unto the ____ God.”
explain: Isaiah 10:21 — “The remnant shall return, even the remnant of Jacob, unto the mighty God.”

q: “Hear, O LORD, and have ____ upon me: LORD, be thou my helper.”
explain: Psalm 30:10 — “Hear, O LORD, and have mercy upon me: LORD, be thou my helper.”

q: “There were they in great ____: for God is in the generation of the righteous.”
explain: Psalm 14:5 — “There were they in great fear: for God is in the generation of the righteous.”

q: “For in the resurrection they neither marry, nor are given in marriage, but are as the angels of God in ____.”
explain: Matthew 22:30 — “For in the resurrection they neither marry, nor are given in marriage, but are as the angels of God in heaven.”

q: “Therefore thou shalt love the LORD thy God, and keep his charge, and his statutes, and his judgments, and his ____, alway.”
explain: Deuteronomy 11:1 — “Therefore thou shalt love the LORD thy God, and keep his charge, and his statutes, and his judgments, and his commandments, alway.”

q: “Philip ____ and telleth Andrew: and again Andrew and Philip tell Jesus.”
explain: John 12:22 — “Philip cometh and telleth Andrew: and again Andrew and Philip tell Jesus.”

q: “But some of them went their ____ to the Pharisees, and told them what things Jesus had done.”
explain: John 11:46 — “But some of them went their ways to the Pharisees, and told them what things Jesus had done.”

q: “Surely he ____ borne our griefs, and carried our sorrows: yet we did esteem him stricken, smitten of God, and afflicted.”
explain: Isaiah 53:4 — “Surely he hath borne our griefs, and carried our sorrows: yet we did esteem him stricken, smitten of God, and afflicted.”

q: “Likewise greet the church that is in their ____. Salute my wellbeloved Epaenetus, who is the firstfruits of Achaia unto Christ.”
explain: Romans 16:5 — “Likewise greet the church that is in their house. Salute my wellbeloved Epaenetus, who is the firstfruits of Achaia unto Christ.”

q: “Jesus therefore, knowing all things that should come upon him, ____ forth, and said unto them, Whom seek ye?”
explain: John 18:4 — “Jesus therefore, knowing all things that should come upon him, went forth, and said unto them, Whom seek ye?”

q: “He therefore that despiseth, despiseth not man, but God, who hath also given unto us his holy ____.”
explain: 1 Thessalonians 4:8 — “He therefore that despiseth, despiseth not man, but God, who hath also given unto us his holy Spirit.”

q: “Yea, they spake against God; they said, Can God furnish a table in the ____?”
explain: Psalm 78:19 — “Yea, they spake against God; they said, Can God furnish a table in the wilderness?”

q: “Grace be unto you, and peace, from God our ____, and from the Lord Jesus Christ.”
explain: Philippians 1:2 — “Grace be unto you, and peace, from God our Father, and from the Lord Jesus Christ.”

q: “The ____ of the LORD divideth the flames of fire.”
explain: Psalm 29:7 — “The voice of the LORD divideth the flames of fire.”

q: “For if Abraham were justified by works, he hath whereof to ____; but not before God.”
explain: Romans 4:2 — “For if Abraham were justified by works, he hath whereof to glory; but not before God.”

q: “The LORD is good to all: and his tender ____ are over all his works.”
explain: Psalm 145:9 — “The LORD is good to all: and his tender mercies are over all his works.”

q: “Oh that men would praise the LORD for his ____, and for his wonderful works to the children of men!”
explain: Psalm 107:21 — “Oh that men would praise the LORD for his goodness, and for his wonderful works to the children of men!”

q: “Blessed be the LORD, because he hath heard the ____ of my supplications.”
explain: Psalm 28:6 — “Blessed be the LORD, because he hath heard the voice of my supplications.”

q: “Unless the LORD had been my ____, my soul had almost dwelt in silence.”
explain: Psalm 94:17 — “Unless the LORD had been my help, my soul had almost dwelt in silence.”

q: “I said, O my God, take me not away in the midst of my days: thy ____ are throughout all generations.”
explain: Psalm 102:24 — “I said, O my God, take me not away in the midst of my days: thy years are throughout all generations.”

q: “Wilt not thou, O God, which hadst cast us off? and thou, O God, which didst not ____ out with our armies?”
explain: Psalm 60:10 — “Wilt not thou, O God, which hadst cast us off? and thou, O God, which didst not go out with our armies?”

q: “When she had heard of Jesus, came in the press behind, and touched his ____.”
explain: Mark 5:27 — “When she had heard of Jesus, came in the press behind, and touched his garment.”

q: “By the which will we are sanctified through the ____ of the body of Jesus Christ once for all.”
explain: Hebrews 10:10 — “By the which will we are sanctified through the offering of the body of Jesus Christ once for all.”

q: “Let us lift up our ____ with our hands unto God in the heavens.”
explain: Lamentations 3:41 — “Let us lift up our heart with our hands unto God in the heavens.”

q: “The ____ departed, and told the Jews that it was Jesus, which had made him whole.”
explain: John 5:15 — “The man departed, and told the Jews that it was Jesus, which had made him whole.”

q: “It is God that avengeth me, and subdueth the ____ under me.”
explain: Psalm 18:47 — “It is God that avengeth me, and subdueth the people under me.”

q: “Heal me, O LORD, and I shall be healed; save me, and I shall be saved: for thou art my ____.”
explain: Jeremiah 17:14 — “Heal me, O LORD, and I shall be healed; save me, and I shall be saved: for thou art my praise.”

q: “The ____ of man bringeth a snare: but whoso putteth his trust in the LORD shall be safe.”
explain: Proverbs 29:25 — “The fear of man bringeth a snare: but whoso putteth his trust in the LORD shall be safe.”

q: “For thou wilt ____ my candle: the LORD my God will enlighten my darkness.”
explain: Psalm 18:28 — “For thou wilt light my candle: the LORD my God will enlighten my darkness.”

q: “But rather seek ye the ____ of God; and all these things shall be added unto you.”
explain: Luke 12:31 — “But rather seek ye the kingdom of God; and all these things shall be added unto you.”

q: “Thy ____, O LORD, endureth for ever; and thy memorial, O LORD, throughout all generations.”
explain: Psalm 135:13 — “Thy name, O LORD, endureth for ever; and thy memorial, O LORD, throughout all generations.”

q: “The curse of the LORD is in the ____ of the wicked: but he blesseth the habitation of the just.”
explain: Proverbs 3:33 — “The curse of the LORD is in the house of the wicked: but he blesseth the habitation of the just.”

q: “God thundereth marvellously with his ____; great things doeth he, which we cannot comprehend.”
explain: Job 37:5 — “God thundereth marvellously with his voice; great things doeth he, which we cannot comprehend.”

q: “God forbid that I should justify you: till I ____ I will not remove mine integrity from me.”
explain: Job 27:5 — “God forbid that I should justify you: till I die I will not remove mine integrity from me.”

q: “Keep not thou silence, O God: hold not thy ____, and be not still, O God.”
explain: Psalm 83:1 — “Keep not thou silence, O God: hold not thy peace, and be not still, O God.”

q: “Thou believest that there is one God; thou doest well: the devils also ____, and tremble.”
explain: James 2:19 — “Thou believest that there is one God; thou doest well: the devils also believe, and tremble.”

q: “O earth, earth, earth, hear the ____ of the LORD.”
explain: Jeremiah 22:29 — “O earth, earth, earth, hear the word of the LORD.”

q: “For the LORD ____ the poor, and despiseth not his prisoners.”
explain: Psalm 69:33 — “For the LORD heareth the poor, and despiseth not his prisoners.”

q: “For in the multitude of dreams and many words there are also divers vanities: but ____ thou God.”
explain: Ecclesiastes 5:7 — “For in the multitude of dreams and many words there are also divers vanities: but fear thou God.”

q: “For if our heart condemn us, God is greater than our heart, and ____ all things.”
explain: 1 John 3:20 — “For if our heart condemn us, God is greater than our heart, and knoweth all things.”

q: “Men groan from out of the ____, and the soul of the wounded crieth out: yet God layeth not folly to them.”
explain: Job 24:12 — “Men groan from out of the city, and the soul of the wounded crieth out: yet God layeth not folly to them.”

q: “The way of the wicked is an abomination unto the LORD: but he loveth him that followeth after ____.”
explain: Proverbs 15:9 — “The way of the wicked is an abomination unto the LORD: but he loveth him that followeth after righteousness.”

q: “The LORD that made ____ and earth bless thee out of Zion.”
explain: Psalm 134:3 — “The LORD that made heaven and earth bless thee out of Zion.”

q: “Stir up thyself, and awake to my ____, even unto my cause, my God and my Lord.”
explain: Psalm 35:23 — “Stir up thyself, and awake to my judgment, even unto my cause, my God and my Lord.”

q: “Jesus ____ and said, He that believeth on me, believeth not on me, but on him that sent me.”
explain: John 12:44 — “Jesus cried and said, He that believeth on me, believeth not on me, but on him that sent me.”

q: “Our soul waiteth for the LORD: he is our help and our ____.”
explain: Psalm 33:20 — “Our soul waiteth for the LORD: he is our help and our shield.”

q: “LORD, I have loved the habitation of thy house, and the place where thine ____ dwelleth.”
explain: Psalm 26:8 — “LORD, I have loved the habitation of thy house, and the place where thine honour dwelleth.”

q: “I waited patiently for the LORD; and he inclined unto me, and ____ my cry.”
explain: Psalm 40:1 — “I waited patiently for the LORD; and he inclined unto me, and heard my cry.”

q: “Let Israel ____ in the LORD from henceforth and for ever.”
explain: Psalm 131:3 — “Let Israel hope in the LORD from henceforth and for ever.”

q: “While I live will I ____ the LORD: I will sing praises unto my God while I have any being.”
explain: Psalm 146:2 — “While I live will I praise the LORD: I will sing praises unto my God while I have any being.”

q: “The ____ that are begotten of them shall enter into the congregation of the LORD in their third generation.”
explain: Deuteronomy 23:8 — “The children that are begotten of them shall enter into the congregation of the LORD in their third generation.”

q: “O come, let us ____ and bow down: let us kneel before the LORD our maker.”
explain: Psalm 95:6 — “O come, let us worship and bow down: let us kneel before the LORD our maker.”

q: “But we have this ____ in earthen vessels, that the excellency of the power may be of God, and not of us.”
explain: 2 Corinthians 4:7 — “But we have this treasure in earthen vessels, that the excellency of the power may be of God, and not of us.”

q: “At the same time came the disciples unto Jesus, saying, Who is the greatest in the ____ of heaven?”
explain: Matthew 18:1 — “At the same time came the disciples unto Jesus, saying, Who is the greatest in the kingdom of heaven?”

q: “I am weary of my crying: my throat is dried: mine ____ fail while I wait for my God.”
explain: Psalm 69:3 — “I am weary of my crying: my throat is dried: mine eyes fail while I wait for my God.”

q: “Brethren, my heart's desire and ____ to God for Israel is, that they might be saved.”
explain: Romans 10:1 — “Brethren, my heart's desire and prayer to God for Israel is, that they might be saved.”

q: “Because that which may be known of God is manifest in them; for God ____ shewed it unto them.”
explain: Romans 1:19 — “Because that which may be known of God is manifest in them; for God hath shewed it unto them.”

q: “I will cry unto God most ____; unto God that performeth all things for me.”
explain: Psalm 57:2 — “I will cry unto God most high; unto God that performeth all things for me.”

q: “Ought not Christ to have suffered these things, and to enter into his ____?”
explain: Luke 24:26 — “Ought not Christ to have suffered these things, and to enter into his glory?”

q: “Others said, This is the Christ. But some said, Shall Christ ____ out of Galilee?”
explain: John 7:41 — “Others said, This is the Christ. But some said, Shall Christ come out of Galilee?”

q: “He is the LORD our God: his judgments are in all the ____.”
explain: Psalm 105:7 — “He is the LORD our God: his judgments are in all the earth.”

q: “Take good heed therefore unto yourselves, that ye ____ the LORD your God.”
explain: Joshua 23:11 — “Take good heed therefore unto yourselves, that ye love the LORD your God.”

q: “Blessed be the LORD: for he hath shewed me his marvellous ____ in a strong city.”
explain: Psalm 31:21 — “Blessed be the LORD: for he hath shewed me his marvellous kindness in a strong city.”

q: “How precious also are thy ____ unto me, O God! how great is the sum of them!”
explain: Psalm 139:17 — “How precious also are thy thoughts unto me, O God! how great is the sum of them!”

q: “Christ is become of no effect unto you, whosoever of you are justified by the law; ye are fallen from ____.”

q: “My friends scorn me: but mine ____ poureth out tears unto God.”
explain: Job 16:20 — “My friends scorn me: but mine eye poureth out tears unto God.”

q: “Until I ____ into the sanctuary of God; then understood I their end.”
explain: Psalm 73:17 — “Until I went into the sanctuary of God; then understood I their end.”

q: “But verily God hath heard me; he hath attended to the voice of my ____.”
explain: Psalm 66:19 — “But verily God hath heard me; he hath attended to the voice of my prayer.”

q: “LORD, what is man, that thou takest ____ of him! or the son of man, that thou makest account of him!”
explain: Psalm 144:3 — “LORD, what is man, that thou takest knowledge of him! or the son of man, that thou makest account of him!”

q: “Serve the LORD with gladness: ____ before his presence with singing.”
explain: Psalm 100:2 — “Serve the LORD with gladness: come before his presence with singing.”

q: “I have stuck unto thy ____: O LORD, put me not to shame.”
explain: Psalm 119:31 — “I have stuck unto thy testimonies: O LORD, put me not to shame.”

q: “The LORD reigneth; let the ____ tremble: he sitteth between the cherubims; let the earth be moved.”
explain: Psalm 99:1 — “The LORD reigneth; let the people tremble: he sitteth between the cherubims; let the earth be moved.”

q: “Hast thou an arm like God? or canst thou thunder with a ____ like him?”
explain: Job 40:9 — “Hast thou an arm like God? or canst thou thunder with a voice like him?”

q: “Peter seeing him saith to Jesus, Lord, and what shall this ____ do?”
explain: John 21:21 — “Peter seeing him saith to Jesus, Lord, and what shall this man do?”

q: “Through God we shall do valiantly: for he it is that shall tread down our ____.”
explain: Psalm 60:12 — “Through God we shall do valiantly: for he it is that shall tread down our enemies.”

q: “But your ____ have seen all the great acts of the LORD which he did.”
explain: Deuteronomy 11:7 — “But your eyes have seen all the great acts of the LORD which he did.”

q: “The voice of rejoicing and ____ is in the tabernacles of the righteous: the right hand of the LORD doeth valiantly.”
explain: Psalm 118:15 — “The voice of rejoicing and salvation is in the tabernacles of the righteous: the right hand of the LORD doeth valiantly.”

q: “But Jesus turning unto them said, ____ of Jerusalem, weep not for me, but weep for yourselves, and for your children.”
explain: Luke 23:28 — “But Jesus turning unto them said, Daughters of Jerusalem, weep not for me, but weep for yourselves, and for your children.”

q: “When the LORD shall build up Zion, he shall appear in his ____.”
explain: Psalm 102:16 — “When the LORD shall build up Zion, he shall appear in his glory.”

q: “But when Jesus perceived their ____, he answering said unto them, What reason ye in your hearts?”
explain: Luke 5:22 — “But when Jesus perceived their thoughts, he answering said unto them, What reason ye in your hearts?”

q: “Some trust in chariots, and some in horses: but we will remember the ____ of the LORD our God.”
explain: Psalm 20:7 — “Some trust in chariots, and some in horses: but we will remember the name of the LORD our God.”

q: “Deliver me, O my God, out of the hand of the wicked, out of the hand of the unrighteous and cruel ____.”
explain: Psalm 71:4 — “Deliver me, O my God, out of the hand of the wicked, out of the hand of the unrighteous and cruel man.”

q: “The same ____ therefore to Philip, which was of Bethsaida of Galilee, and desired him, saying, Sir, we would see Jesus.”
explain: John 12:21 — “The same came therefore to Philip, which was of Bethsaida of Galilee, and desired him, saying, Sir, we would see Jesus.”

q: “Exalt the LORD our God, and ____ at his holy hill; for the LORD our God is holy.”
explain: Psalm 99:9 — “Exalt the LORD our God, and worship at his holy hill; for the LORD our God is holy.”

q: “I will offer to thee the ____ of thanksgiving, and will call upon the name of the LORD.”
explain: Psalm 116:17 — “I will offer to thee the sacrifice of thanksgiving, and will call upon the name of the LORD.”

q: “Who hath directed the ____ of the LORD, or being his counsellor hath taught him?”
explain: Isaiah 40:13 — “Who hath directed the Spirit of the LORD, or being his counsellor hath taught him?”

q: “James, a ____ of God and of the Lord Jesus Christ, to the twelve tribes which are scattered abroad, greeting.”
explain: James 1:1 — “James, a servant of God and of the Lord Jesus Christ, to the twelve tribes which are scattered abroad, greeting.”

q: “Hear my prayer, O LORD, give ear to my supplications: in thy faithfulness answer me, and in thy ____.”
explain: Psalm 143:1 — “Hear my prayer, O LORD, give ear to my supplications: in thy faithfulness answer me, and in thy righteousness.”

q: “Thou art my God, and I will ____ thee: thou art my God, I will exalt thee.”
explain: Psalm 118:28 — “Thou art my God, and I will praise thee: thou art my God, I will exalt thee.”

q: “I do not frustrate the grace of God: for if ____ come by the law, then Christ is dead in vain.”
explain: Galatians 2:21 — “I do not frustrate the grace of God: for if righteousness come by the law, then Christ is dead in vain.”

q: “For he looked for a ____ which hath foundations, whose builder and maker is God.”
explain: Hebrews 11:10 — “For he looked for a city which hath foundations, whose builder and maker is God.”

q: “Shall any teach God ____? seeing he judgeth those that are high.”
explain: Job 21:22 — “Shall any teach God knowledge? seeing he judgeth those that are high.”

q: “After this, Jesus knowing that all things were now accomplished, that the scripture might be fulfilled, saith, I ____.”
explain: John 19:28 — “After this, Jesus knowing that all things were now accomplished, that the scripture might be fulfilled, saith, I thirst.”

q: “Hezekiah also had said, What is the sign that I shall go up to the ____ of the LORD?”
explain: Isaiah 38:22 — “Hezekiah also had said, What is the sign that I shall go up to the house of the LORD?”

q: “But if ye will not hear these words, I swear by myself, saith the LORD, that this ____ shall become a desolation.”
explain: Jeremiah 22:5 — “But if ye will not hear these words, I swear by myself, saith the LORD, that this house shall become a desolation.”

q: “I wait for the LORD, my ____ doth wait, and in his word do I hope.”
explain: Psalm 130:5 — “I wait for the LORD, my soul doth wait, and in his word do I hope.”

q: “Wherewith thine ____ have reproached, O LORD; wherewith they have reproached the footsteps of thine anointed.”
explain: Psalm 89:51 — “Wherewith thine enemies have reproached, O LORD; wherewith they have reproached the footsteps of thine anointed.”

q: “Have the workers of iniquity no ____? who eat up my people as they eat bread: they have not called upon God.”
explain: Psalm 53:4 — “Have the workers of iniquity no knowledge? who eat up my people as they eat bread: they have not called upon God.”

q: “For the wrath of man worketh not the ____ of God.”
explain: James 1:20 — “For the wrath of man worketh not the righteousness of God.”

q: “God judgeth the righteous, and God is angry with the wicked every ____.”
explain: Psalm 7:11 — “God judgeth the righteous, and God is angry with the wicked every day.”

q: “Arise, O LORD; O God, lift up thine ____: forget not the humble.”
explain: Psalm 10:12 — “Arise, O LORD; O God, lift up thine hand: forget not the humble.”

q: “Whatsoever the LORD pleased, that did he in ____, and in earth, in the seas, and all deep places.”
explain: Psalm 135:6 — “Whatsoever the LORD pleased, that did he in heaven, and in earth, in the seas, and all deep places.”

q: “Howl ye; for the day of the LORD is at ____; it shall come as a destruction from the Almighty.”
explain: Isaiah 13:6 — “Howl ye; for the day of the LORD is at hand; it shall come as a destruction from the Almighty.”

q: “Not that any ____ hath seen the Father, save he which is of God, he hath seen the Father.”
explain: John 6:46 — “Not that any man hath seen the Father, save he which is of God, he hath seen the Father.”

q: “Who knoweth not in all these that the ____ of the LORD hath wrought this?”
explain: Job 12:9 — “Who knoweth not in all these that the hand of the LORD hath wrought this?”

q: “Jesus answered and said unto them, Ye do err, not knowing the scriptures, nor the ____ of God.”
explain: Matthew 22:29 — “Jesus answered and said unto them, Ye do err, not knowing the scriptures, nor the power of God.”

q: “For who ____ known the mind of the Lord, that he may instruct him? But we have the mind of Christ.”
explain: 1 Corinthians 2:16 — “For who hath known the mind of the Lord, that he may instruct him? But we have the mind of Christ.”

q: “He shall receive the blessing from the LORD, and ____ from the God of his salvation.”
explain: Psalm 24:5 — “He shall receive the blessing from the LORD, and righteousness from the God of his salvation.”

q: “As with a ____ in my bones, mine enemies reproach me; while they say daily unto me, Where is thy God?”
explain: Psalm 42:10 — “As with a sword in my bones, mine enemies reproach me; while they say daily unto me, Where is thy God?”

q: “For even Christ pleased not himself; but, as it is written, The reproaches of them that reproached thee ____ on me.”
explain: Romans 15:3 — “For even Christ pleased not himself; but, as it is written, The reproaches of them that reproached thee fell on me.”

q: “Yet if any ____ suffer as a Christian, let him not be ashamed; but let him glorify God on this behalf.”
explain: 1 Peter 4:16 — “Yet if any man suffer as a Christian, let him not be ashamed; but let him glorify God on this behalf.”

q: “Thus speaketh the LORD of hosts, the God of Israel, saying, I have broken the yoke of the ____ of Babylon.”
explain: Jeremiah 28:2 — “Thus speaketh the LORD of hosts, the God of Israel, saying, I have broken the yoke of the king of Babylon.”

q: “But thanks be to God, which put the same earnest care into the ____ of Titus for you.”
explain: 2 Corinthians 8:16 — “But thanks be to God, which put the same earnest care into the heart of Titus for you.”

q: “The LORD is great in Zion; and he is high above all the ____.”
explain: Psalm 99:2 — “The LORD is great in Zion; and he is high above all the people.”

q: “Thou answeredst them, O LORD our God: thou wast a God that forgavest them, though thou tookest ____ of their inventions.”
explain: Psalm 99:8 — “Thou answeredst them, O LORD our God: thou wast a God that forgavest them, though thou tookest vengeance of their inventions.”

q: “These are the two olive trees, and the two candlesticks standing before the God of the ____.”
explain: Revelation 11:4 — “These are the two olive trees, and the two candlesticks standing before the God of the earth.”

q: “Thou lovest ____, and hatest wickedness: therefore God, thy God, hath anointed thee with the oil of gladness above thy fellows.”
explain: Psalm 45:7 — “Thou lovest righteousness, and hatest wickedness: therefore God, thy God, hath anointed thee with the oil of gladness above thy fellows.”

q: “But Jesus took him by the ____, and lifted him up; and he arose.”
explain: Mark 9:27 — “But Jesus took him by the hand, and lifted him up; and he arose.”

q: “Yet the LORD hath not given you an ____ to perceive, and eyes to see, and ears to hear, unto this day.”
explain: Deuteronomy 29:4 — “Yet the LORD hath not given you an heart to perceive, and eyes to see, and ears to hear, unto this day.”

q: “The LORD preserveth the simple: I was ____ low, and he helped me.”
explain: Psalm 116:6 — “The LORD preserveth the simple: I was brought low, and he helped me.”

q: “The ____ priest then asked Jesus of his disciples, and of his doctrine.”
explain: John 18:19 — “The high priest then asked Jesus of his disciples, and of his doctrine.”

q: “Jesus answered them, Is it not written in your ____, I said, Ye are gods?”
explain: John 10:34 — “Jesus answered them, Is it not written in your law, I said, Ye are gods?”

q: “Be not afraid of their faces: for I am with thee to ____ thee, saith the LORD.”
explain: Jeremiah 1:8 — “Be not afraid of their faces: for I am with thee to deliver thee, saith the LORD.”

q: “Examine me, O LORD, and prove me; try my reins and my ____.”
explain: Psalm 26:2 — “Examine me, O LORD, and prove me; try my reins and my heart.”

q: “The God and ____ of our Lord Jesus Christ, which is blessed for evermore, knoweth that I lie not.”
explain: 2 Corinthians 11:31 — “The God and Father of our Lord Jesus Christ, which is blessed for evermore, knoweth that I lie not.”

q: “I have preached ____ in the great congregation: lo, I have not refrained my lips, O LORD, thou knowest.”
explain: Psalm 40:9 — “I have preached righteousness in the great congregation: lo, I have not refrained my lips, O LORD, thou knowest.”

q: “The righteous shall be glad in the LORD, and shall trust in him; and all the upright in ____ shall glory.”
explain: Psalm 64:10 — “The righteous shall be glad in the LORD, and shall trust in him; and all the upright in heart shall glory.”

q: “Wait on the LORD: be of good courage, and he shall strengthen thine ____: wait, I say, on the LORD.”
explain: Psalm 27:14 — “Wait on the LORD: be of good courage, and he shall strengthen thine heart: wait, I say, on the LORD.”

q: “He hath said in his ____, God hath forgotten: he hideth his face; he will never see it.”
explain: Psalm 10:11 — “He hath said in his heart, God hath forgotten: he hideth his face; he will never see it.”

q: “But them that are without God judgeth. Therefore put away from among yourselves that ____ person.”
explain: 1 Corinthians 5:13 — “But them that are without God judgeth. Therefore put away from among yourselves that wicked person.”

q: “Being born again, not of corruptible ____, but of incorruptible, by the word of God, which liveth and abideth for ever.”
explain: 1 Peter 1:23 — “Being born again, not of corruptible seed, but of incorruptible, by the word of God, which liveth and abideth for ever.”

q: “Thou therefore endure hardness, as a ____ soldier of Jesus Christ.”
explain: 2 Timothy 2:3 — “Thou therefore endure hardness, as a good soldier of Jesus Christ.”

q: “There be many that say, Who will shew us any good? LORD, lift thou up the ____ of thy countenance upon us.”
explain: Psalm 4:6 — “There be many that say, Who will shew us any good? LORD, lift thou up the light of thy countenance upon us.”

q: “For God sent not his ____ into the world to condemn the world; but that the world through him might be saved.”
explain: John 3:17 — “For God sent not his Son into the world to condemn the world; but that the world through him might be saved.”

q: “He hath made his wonderful ____ to be remembered: the LORD is gracious and full of compassion.”
explain: Psalm 111:4 — “He hath made his wonderful works to be remembered: the LORD is gracious and full of compassion.”

q: “For thus saith the LORD; We have heard a ____ of trembling, of fear, and not of peace.”
explain: Jeremiah 30:5 — “For thus saith the LORD; We have heard a voice of trembling, of fear, and not of peace.”

q: “Teach me, O LORD, the ____ of thy statutes; and I shall keep it unto the end.”
explain: Psalm 119:33 — “Teach me, O LORD, the way of thy statutes; and I shall keep it unto the end.”

q: “Behold, the LORD maketh the ____ empty, and maketh it waste, and turneth it upside down, and scattereth abroad the inhabitants thereof.”
explain: Isaiah 24:1 — “Behold, the LORD maketh the earth empty, and maketh it waste, and turneth it upside down, and scattereth abroad the inhabitants thereof.”

q: “But God giveth it a body as it hath pleased him, and to every ____ his own body.”
explain: 1 Corinthians 15:38 — “But God giveth it a body as it hath pleased him, and to every seed his own body.”

q: “For Christ is the end of the law for ____ to every one that believeth.”
explain: Romans 10:4 — “For Christ is the end of the law for righteousness to every one that believeth.”

q: “The LORD is ____ in all his ways, and holy in all his works.”
explain: Psalm 145:17 — “The LORD is righteous in all his ways, and holy in all his works.”

q: “Have ____ upon me, O LORD; for I am weak: O LORD, heal me; for my bones are vexed.”
explain: Psalm 6:2 — “Have mercy upon me, O LORD; for I am weak: O LORD, heal me; for my bones are vexed.”

q: “Multitudes, multitudes in the valley of decision: for the ____ of the LORD is near in the valley of decision.”
explain: Joel 3:14 — “Multitudes, multitudes in the valley of decision: for the day of the LORD is near in the valley of decision.”

q: “Thy ____ is like the great mountains; thy judgments are a great deep: O LORD, thou preservest man and beast.”
explain: Psalm 36:6 — “Thy righteousness is like the great mountains; thy judgments are a great deep: O LORD, thou preservest man and beast.”

q: “The LORD your God hath multiplied you, and, behold, ye are this day as the stars of ____ for multitude.”
explain: Deuteronomy 1:10 — “The LORD your God hath multiplied you, and, behold, ye are this day as the stars of heaven for multitude.”

q: “Those that be planted in the ____ of the LORD shall flourish in the courts of our God.”
explain: Psalm 92:13 — “Those that be planted in the house of the LORD shall flourish in the courts of our God.”

q: “Whither the forerunner is for us entered, even Jesus, made an ____ priest for ever after the order of Melchisedec.”
explain: Hebrews 6:20 — “Whither the forerunner is for us entered, even Jesus, made an high priest for ever after the order of Melchisedec.”

q: “Behold, O God our ____, and look upon the face of thine anointed.”
explain: Psalm 84:9 — “Behold, O God our shield, and look upon the face of thine anointed.”

q: “The LORD shall preserve thee from all evil: he shall preserve thy ____.”
explain: Psalm 121:7 — “The LORD shall preserve thee from all evil: he shall preserve thy soul.”

q: “Am I a God at ____, saith the LORD, and not a God afar off?”
explain: Jeremiah 23:23 — “Am I a God at hand, saith the LORD, and not a God afar off?”

q: “Stand fast therefore in the ____ wherewith Christ hath made us free, and be not entangled again with the yoke of bondage.”
explain: Galatians 5:1 — “Stand fast therefore in the liberty wherewith Christ hath made us free, and be not entangled again with the yoke of bondage.”

q: “Thou shalt ____ the LORD thy God, and serve him, and shalt swear by his name.”
explain: Deuteronomy 6:13 — “Thou shalt fear the LORD thy God, and serve him, and shalt swear by his name.”

q: “For the ____ is the LORD'S: and he is the governor among the nations.”
explain: Psalm 22:28 — “For the kingdom is the LORD'S: and he is the governor among the nations.”

q: “For indeed the ____ of the LORD was against them, to destroy them from among the host, until they were consumed.”
explain: Deuteronomy 2:15 — “For indeed the hand of the LORD was against them, to destroy them from among the host, until they were consumed.”

q: “For thus saith the LORD; Behold, he shall fly as an ____, and shall spread his wings over Moab.”
explain: Jeremiah 48:40 — “For thus saith the LORD; Behold, he shall fly as an eagle, and shall spread his wings over Moab.”

q: “Not unto us, O LORD, not unto us, but unto thy name give ____, for thy mercy, and for thy truth's sake.”
explain: Psalm 115:1 — “Not unto us, O LORD, not unto us, but unto thy name give glory, for thy mercy, and for thy truth's sake.”

q: “As for the ____ that thou hast spoken unto us in the name of the LORD, we will not hearken unto thee.”
explain: Jeremiah 44:16 — “As for the word that thou hast spoken unto us in the name of the LORD, we will not hearken unto thee.”

q: “Whose are the fathers, and of whom as concerning the ____ Christ came, who is over all, God blessed for ever. Amen.”
explain: Romans 9:5 — “Whose are the fathers, and of whom as concerning the flesh Christ came, who is over all, God blessed for ever. Amen.”

q: “I was glad when they said unto me, Let us go into the ____ of the LORD.”
explain: Psalm 122:1 — “I was glad when they said unto me, Let us go into the house of the LORD.”

q: “The young lions roar after their prey, and ____ their meat from God.”
explain: Psalm 104:21 — “The young lions roar after their prey, and seek their meat from God.”

q: “Yea, the LORD shall give that which is ____; and our land shall yield her increase.”
explain: Psalm 85:12 — “Yea, the LORD shall give that which is good; and our land shall yield her increase.”

q: “Jesus saith unto her, Said I not unto thee, that, if thou wouldest believe, thou shouldest see the ____ of God?”
explain: John 11:40 — “Jesus saith unto her, Said I not unto thee, that, if thou wouldest believe, thou shouldest see the glory of God?”

q: “Teach me to do thy will; for thou art my God: thy ____ is good; lead me into the land of uprightness.”
explain: Psalm 143:10 — “Teach me to do thy will; for thou art my God: thy spirit is good; lead me into the land of uprightness.”

q: “Be not wroth very sore, O LORD, neither remember ____ for ever: behold, see, we beseech thee, we are all thy people.”
explain: Isaiah 64:9 — “Be not wroth very sore, O LORD, neither remember iniquity for ever: behold, see, we beseech thee, we are all thy people.”

q: “Let that day be darkness; let not God regard it from above, neither let the ____ shine upon it.”
explain: Job 3:4 — “Let that day be darkness; let not God regard it from above, neither let the light shine upon it.”

q: “O LORD, truly I am thy servant; I am thy servant, and the ____ of thine handmaid: thou hast loosed my bonds.”
explain: Psalm 116:16 — “O LORD, truly I am thy servant; I am thy servant, and the son of thine handmaid: thou hast loosed my bonds.”

q: “There is no wisdom nor ____ nor counsel against the LORD.”
explain: Proverbs 21:30 — “There is no wisdom nor understanding nor counsel against the LORD.”

q: “They shall lift up their ____, they shall sing for the majesty of the LORD, they shall cry aloud from the sea.”
explain: Isaiah 24:14 — “They shall lift up their voice, they shall sing for the majesty of the LORD, they shall cry aloud from the sea.”

q: “Preserve my soul; for I am holy: O thou my God, save thy ____ that trusteth in thee.”
explain: Psalm 86:2 — “Preserve my soul; for I am holy: O thou my God, save thy servant that trusteth in thee.”

q: “For the LORD is good; his ____ is everlasting; and his truth endureth to all generations.”
explain: Psalm 100:5 — “For the LORD is good; his mercy is everlasting; and his truth endureth to all generations.”

q: “The grass withereth, the flower fadeth: because the ____ of the LORD bloweth upon it: surely the people is grass.”
explain: Isaiah 40:7 — “The grass withereth, the flower fadeth: because the spirit of the LORD bloweth upon it: surely the people is grass.”

q: “When Jesus therefore had received the vinegar, he said, It is finished: and he bowed his head, and ____ up the ghost.”
explain: John 19:30 — “When Jesus therefore had received the vinegar, he said, It is finished: and he bowed his head, and gave up the ghost.”

q: “By so much was Jesus ____ a surety of a better testament.”
explain: Hebrews 7:22 — “By so much was Jesus made a surety of a better testament.”

q: “If ye then be risen with Christ, seek those things which are above, where Christ sitteth on the right ____ of God.”
explain: Colossians 3:1 — “If ye then be risen with Christ, seek those things which are above, where Christ sitteth on the right hand of God.”

q: “Sanctify the LORD of hosts himself; and let him be your ____, and let him be your dread.”
explain: Isaiah 8:13 — “Sanctify the LORD of hosts himself; and let him be your fear, and let him be your dread.”

q: “Is not the meat cut off before our eyes, yea, joy and gladness from the ____ of our God?”
explain: Joel 1:16 — “Is not the meat cut off before our eyes, yea, joy and gladness from the house of our God?”

q: “But Jesus said unto him, ____ me; and let the dead bury their dead.”
explain: Matthew 8:22 — “But Jesus said unto him, Follow me; and let the dead bury their dead.”

q: “The fear of the LORD is a fountain of life, to depart from the snares of ____.”
explain: Proverbs 14:27 — “The fear of the LORD is a fountain of life, to depart from the snares of death.”

q: “A just weight and balance are the LORD'S: all the weights of the bag are his ____.”
explain: Proverbs 16:11 — “A just weight and balance are the LORD'S: all the weights of the bag are his work.”

q: “To do justice and judgment is more acceptable to the LORD than ____.”
explain: Proverbs 21:3 — “To do justice and judgment is more acceptable to the LORD than sacrifice.”

q: “They ____ him, Jesus of Nazareth. Jesus saith unto them, I am he. And Judas also, which betrayed him, stood with them.”
explain: John 18:5 — “They answered him, Jesus of Nazareth. Jesus saith unto them, I am he. And Judas also, which betrayed him, stood with them.”

q: “If thou, LORD, shouldest mark ____, O Lord, who shall stand?”
explain: Psalm 130:3 — “If thou, LORD, shouldest mark iniquities, O Lord, who shall stand?”

q: “Lo, children are an heritage of the LORD: and the fruit of the womb is his ____.”
explain: Psalm 127:3 — “Lo, children are an heritage of the LORD: and the fruit of the womb is his reward.”

q: “For whoso findeth me findeth life, and shall obtain ____ of the LORD.”
explain: Proverbs 8:35 — “For whoso findeth me findeth life, and shall obtain favour of the LORD.”

q: “These see the ____ of the LORD, and his wonders in the deep.”
explain: Psalm 107:24 — “These see the works of the LORD, and his wonders in the deep.”

q: “Arise, O God, plead thine own cause: remember how the foolish ____ reproacheth thee daily.”
explain: Psalm 74:22 — “Arise, O God, plead thine own cause: remember how the foolish man reproacheth thee daily.”

q: “Jesus therefore again groaning in himself cometh to the ____. It was a cave, and a stone lay upon it.”
explain: John 11:38 — “Jesus therefore again groaning in himself cometh to the grave. It was a cave, and a stone lay upon it.”

q: “Better is little with the fear of the LORD than great ____ and trouble therewith.”
explain: Proverbs 15:16 — “Better is little with the fear of the LORD than great treasure and trouble therewith.”

q: “Who is this King of glory? The LORD strong and mighty, the LORD mighty in ____.”
explain: Psalm 24:8 — “Who is this King of glory? The LORD strong and mighty, the LORD mighty in battle.”

q: “Every man shall give as he is able, according to the ____ of the LORD thy God which he hath given thee.”
explain: Deuteronomy 16:17 — “Every man shall give as he is able, according to the blessing of the LORD thy God which he hath given thee.”

q: “Yea, many ____ and strong nations shall come to seek the LORD of hosts in Jerusalem, and to pray before the LORD.”
explain: Zechariah 8:22 — “Yea, many people and strong nations shall come to seek the LORD of hosts in Jerusalem, and to pray before the LORD.”

q: “Render unto them a recompence, O LORD, according to the ____ of their hands.”
explain: Lamentations 3:64 — “Render unto them a recompence, O LORD, according to the work of their hands.”

q: “They that trust in the LORD shall be as mount Zion, which cannot be removed, but ____ for ever.”
explain: Psalm 125:1 — “They that trust in the LORD shall be as mount Zion, which cannot be removed, but abideth for ever.”

q: “Like as a ____ pitieth his children, so the LORD pitieth them that fear him.”
